description.value: The Billy Lewis Centenary Rose Garden is a public rose garden located within Bowen Park in Nanaimo, BC. It is a named ornamental garden feature managed by the City of Nanaimo as part of its broader parks system. Cyclists touring Nanaimo's urban parks may encounter it as a scenic stop, though it is a sub-feature of the larger Bowen Park rather than a standalone facility.
